author: SenSeiTs
quote: Almost no innovations. Buggy launch, no physical copy. Repetitive boring missions, trash progression. Cuck simulator. Rigged scores. Blacklisted journalists. 30 damn FPS that drops even lower at times after 13 years. Doing chores for 6 hours isn't gameplay. There are games that are 6-8 hours of quality story and then you have this which has about 6-8 hour unskillable chores missions. Npcs are a bit more responsive. The art director is just super realism so nothing special, just good graphics. And don't even get me started about the extremely obvious masonic messaging in the game. Shouldn't even give the game a 3 to be real. Pathetic game after 13 years of developing and 2 billions wasted. Luckily the game will make profit out of all the goys that enjoy slop.
